news.title: Treasury Rally Extends, Lifts Asian Stocks and Bonds – Asia Market Wrap
news.description: Treasuries extended gains fueled by US plans to buy back longer-maturity debt, boosting sentiment and lifting Asian bonds and stocks. The Dollar steadied after sliding to a three-month low. The US 30-year yield fell 1 bp to 5.18% after sliding 9 bps Wednesday. The benchmark 10-year yield dropped by a similar amount to 4.63%, extending its 6 bp decline in the previous session. An index of Treasuries due in 20 years and above had jumped 1.7% Wednesday, its biggest one-day gain since February 2025.
